notes.title: Sect Leader's Decree Joins Indie Assemble + New Playtest Now Live!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to share that Sect Leader’s Decree is taking part in Indie Assemble — and we’re launching a new playtest to celebrate!
The playtest runs [b]until May 11th[/b], and we’d love for you to give it a try (and check out the other great games featured in the event!).
Indie Assemble page will be live from May 5, 2025, at 10:00 AM PT (7:00 PM CET) until May 11 at the same time.

Based on your feedback from the last playtest, we’ve added resource info on hover — a small but meaningful quality-of-life improvement. Let us know what you think — your input truly helps to shape the game!
We’re also hard at work on the deeper cultivation system, which will be arriving soon.

[i]Note: While the full game will support multiple languages, this playtest is English-only.[/i]

Thanks again for your support, and enjoy the festival!

[i]— Alena & Anna [/i]

notes.title: The second Playtest is now live!
notes.notes:
Join us from [b]March 23rd to April 2nd[/b] for the second playtest of the Sect Leader’s Decree!

We’d love to hear your thoughts — give it a try and share your feedback!

[i]Note: While the full game will support multiple languages, this playtest is English-only.[/i]

Changes from the Playtest 1 version:
	- Added a step by step tutorial 
	- Added a river square, allowing for fishing 
  - Cooking recipes now show total amount of resources needed, instead of being per Character 
	- Changed wording on some Events 
	- Tabs in the buildings are more visible now 
	
Fixed bugs: 
	- Fixed skills shown as invalid in some places  
	- When building is decayed completely, the cost to repair it only increases to a limit of how much it would cost to construct this building from scratch 
	- Fixed the bug when cooking the same recipe in two kitchens would, the second one would override the first 

[i]— Alena & Anna [/i]

notes.title: Playtest Has Ended – Thank You!

[i]— Alena & Anna[/i]

notes.title: Welcome to the Sect Leader’s Decree Steam Page!
notes.notes:
Greetings, cultivators!

Thank you for visiting our page and showing interest in Sect Leader’s Decree! Your support means a lot as we continue developing this turn-based colony builder set in a mystical, cultivation-inspired world.

While there’s still plenty to refine and expand, most of the core features are already in place, and we’re excited to announce that a playtest is planned for the end of February! 

If you’d like to be among the first to try the game, register for the playtest now! We’d love to hear your thoughts and improve the game with your help.

[b]Please note: While Sect Leader’s Decree will be translated into multiple languages at launch, this playtest will be English-only.[/b]

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you again for your interest and support!

[i]— Alena & Anna [/i]
